Person(name: "Ada", age: 32, active: true)
Person(name: "Grace", age: 37, active: false)
Employee(name: "Lin", address: {city: "Delhi", zip: 110001}, skills: [compiler, vm, isa])

Animal(name: "root")
Mammal extend Animal(name: "mammal")
Cat extend Mammal(name: "felidae")

Engineer extend Employee, TechnicalPerson(name: "Ada", level: 5)
main() => return commonAncestors(left: Engineer(name: "Ada"), right: TechnicalPerson(name: "Lin"))

add(left: number, right: number) =>
    return left + right

classify(score: number) =>
    if score >= 80 then
        return "high"
    else
        return "low"

adult(person: Person) =>
    where person.age >= 18
    return true
else
    return false
main() => return {both: true and not false, either: false or true, exact: 4 == 4}
main() => return {add: 6 + 7, sub: 20 - 3, mul: 6 * 7, div: 84 / 2, mod: 17 % 5}

Values := [1, 2, 3, {name: "four", value: 4}]
main() => return {values: Values, count: count(Values)}

main() =>
    engineers := lambda(Employee, employee => employee.role == "engineer")
    return engineers

degreeFor(profile: RatingProfile) => return membership(68, profile)
main() => return for_each_fact(RatingProfile, degreeFor)
main() => return membership(68, {peak: 75, fades_in: 50, fades_out: 90})
main() => return {text: similarity("cat", "cats"), number: similarity(9, 10)}
main() => return {identity: semantic_identity(42), degree: semantic_evaluate_degree(0.75)}

@mixfix(pattern: "between {value:number} and {limit:number}", precedence: 40, associativity: "left")
betweenRange() => return value <= limit
main() => return {accepted: between 5 and 10, rejected: between 12 and 10}

import ("math", "str", "array")
main() => return math:sqrt(value: 81)
main() => return {length: array.len(data: [1, 2, 3]), text: str:upper(data: "felidae")}
main() => return {quote: "say \"hello\"", path: "build/debug/program.bin", newline: "a\nb"}

Café(name: "東京", note: "naïve façade λ calculus 🐈")
main() => return Café(name: "München")

# deterministic compiler comment
main() => return 42 # trailing explanation
main() => return {missing: nil, false_value: false, true_value: true, numeric_false: 0.0, numeric_true: 1.0}

factorial(n: number) =>
    if n == 0 then
        return 1
    else
        return n * factorial(n: n - 1)
main() => return factorial(n: 6)

Parent(parent: "alice", child: "bob")
Parent(parent: "bob", child: "carol")
ancestor(edge: Parent) => return edge.parent == "alice"
main() => return for_each_fact(Parent, ancestor)

Event(name: "deploy", effective_at: 1724544000, priority: 10)
Event(name: "review", effective_at: 1724630400, priority: 5)
main() => return (size: tensor.size(value: [[1, 2], [3, 4]]), shape: tensor.shape(value: [[1, 2], [3, 4]]), dimensions: tensor.dimensions(value: [[1, 2], [3, 4]]))
main() => return (difference: tensor.difference(left: [1, 4], right: [3, 1]), similarity: tensor.cosineSimilarity(left: [1, 0], right: [1, 1]))
main() => return (transpose: tensor.transpose(value: [[1, 2], [3, 4]]), symmetric: tensor.isSymmetric(value: [[1, 2], [2, 1]]), copy: tensor.clone(value: [1, 2, 3]))

Observation(sensor: "", state: "", value: 0)
main() =>
    reading := Observation(sensor: "indoor", state: "steady", value: 21.5)
    changed := Observation(sensor: "indoor", state: "steady", value: 24.0)
    features := tensor.clone(value: reading)
    return (size: tensor.size(value: reading), shape: tensor.shape(value: reading), similarity: tensor.cosineSimilarity(left: reading, right: features), difference: tensor.difference(left: reading, right: changed))
